member.name: P:TrueAutomation.WorkflowService.Engine.IWorkflowManager.Started
member.summary: Delegate used to notify the host application that a workflow instance has started. The first method parameter is the id of the workflow being started and the second is an optional table of input parameters to be passed to the new workflow instance.

member.name: P:TrueAutomation.WorkflowService.Engine.IWorkflowManager.Resumed
member.summary: Delegate used to notify the host application that a workflow instance has resumed. The first method parameter is the id of the workflow being resumed, the second is the name of the bookmark at which to resume processing, and the third is an optional value being passed into the workflow.

member.summary: Delegate used to notify the host application that a workflow instance has completed processing. The first method parameter is the id of the workflow that is being completed, the second is a table of output arguments being returned by the completed workflow.

member.name: P:TrueAutomation.WorkflowService.Engine.IWorkflowManager.Unloaded

member.name: P:TrueAutomation.WorkflowService.Engine.IWorkflowManager.Incomplete
member.summary: Delegate used to notify the host application that a workflow instance has not completed processing. The first argument is the id of the workflow that failed to complete running. The second is the name of the reason why the workflow didn't complete, such as "Canceled" or "Faulted". The third argument specifies any additional data associated with the event, such as a description of any specific fault that occurredm or other data applicable to the event.

member.name: M:TrueAutomation.WorkflowService.Engine.WorkflowManager.SetupWorkflowInstance(System.Guid@,System.Activities.Activity,System.Collections.Generic.IDictionary{System.String,System.Object},System.Boolean)
member.summary: Implementation method responsible for creation of a new instance. This method creates the instance and assigns a set of standard delegate handlers to it for handling various workflow-related events. It also sets the instance store and adds any custom extensions to the workflow application instance. If the method is passed a non-empty instanceId value, the workflow application's method is invoked to load the designated workflow instance from the instance store.
member.param: The id of the workflow instance to create. If this value is Guid.Empty then a new workflow instance is created, otherwise the method will attempt to load an existing workflow instance with the specified ID from the associated instance store.
The workflow activity to load.
A lookup table of parameters to pass to the new workflow instance. May be null if no input arguments are required by the workflow activity.
member.returns: A fully-initialized workflow instance for the specified workflow.
